title: Phone message slip (While You Were Out)
description: A classic pink 'WHILE YOU WERE OUT' phone message slip, filled in by hand by whoever took the call. Used for media inquiries and any urgent call-back. Write the message the way a receptionist jots it down: quotes of what the caller said, capitals for the scary parts.

time.description: Time of the call, without AM/PM

fromOrg.description: Caller's organization (the 'of' line). For media, the outlet; defaults to brand.aliases.localTv when empty.

message.description: Handwritten message. Keep under ~450 characters so it fits the ruled lines.
examples: We are getting viewer photos of 'Flight 666' on your boards. We need a statement NOW.

deadline.description: Deadline scrawled in red and underlined at the bottom of the message

takenBy.description: Initials or first name of whoever took the call (the 'Signed' line)
